definitions.explanation: Describes a sensation, environment, or experience that feels pleasant and soothing. Conveys a gentle, refined sense of comfort rather than mere physical ease.

examples.japanese: {心地|ここち}よい{風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}いている。
{心地|ここち}よい{音楽|おんがく}に{包|つつ}まれてリラックスした。
examples.english: I relaxed, enveloped by pleasant music.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}の{日差|ひざ}しが{心地|ここち}よく、つい{散歩|さんぽ}の{時間|じかん}が{長|なが}くなった。
examples.english: The spring sunlight was so pleasant that my walk ended up being longer than planned.

notes:
USAGE:
A slightly literary and refined alternative to {気持|きも}ちいい (feels good). The base noun {心地|ここち} means "feeling" or "sensation" and appears in compounds like {住|す}み{心地|ごこち} (comfort of living in a place) and {寝心地|ねごこち} (sleeping comfort). When {心地|ここち} appears in compounds, it is read ごこち.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心地|ここち}よい{風|かぜ}: pleasant breeze
- {心地|ここち}よい{眠|ねむ}り: comfortable sleep
- {心地|ここち}よい{疲|つか}れ: pleasant tiredness (after exercise)
- {心地|ここち}よく{過|す}ごす: to spend time comfortably
